Eventually someone will die in a self-driving car and it will keep going to its destination.

Imagine in 200 years how people will look back at us, with videos and pictures of our highways and traffic jams, and just marvel at how insanely intricate and talented everyone had to be to prevent mass destruction.

The idea of being able to drive for 2 hours, under your own control, at high speeds, and not only not kill everyone around you but to know the roads and traffic patterns to the point where you could reach your destination unaided in any way.

Sometimes I think the fact we taught a few hundred million people how to safely navigate a 2 ton vehicle at 70+ miles per hour without assured mutual destruction is one of the greatest achievements of the 20th century.
